requirements.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
requirements.control_name: Inventory and Control of Enterprise Assets
requirements.guidance: Inventory all enterprise assets, including regularly connected assets outside enterprise control; record ownership, identifiers and authorization status, and reconcile changes.

requirements.title: Address Unauthorized Assets
requirements.control_name: Inventory and Control of Enterprise Assets
requirements.guidance: Remove, block or isolate devices that lack authorization.

requirements.title: Utilize an Active Discovery Tool
requirements.control_name: Inventory and Control of Enterprise Assets
requirements.guidance: Discover connected devices automatically. Run discovery and reconcile unexpected devices.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: IT/provider discovers and reconciles; client owners resolve authorization.
operating_guidance.establish: Configure discovery coverage and accountable operator.
operating_guidance.operate: Run discovery and reconcile unexpected devices.

requirements.title: Use Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP) Logging to Update Enterprise Asset Inventory
requirements.control_name: Inventory and Control of Enterprise Assets
requirements.source_cadence: At least weekly inventory updates using logs.
requirements.guidance: Feed address-allocation observations into inventory. Collect observations and resolve inventory differences.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: IT/provider discovers and reconciles; client owners resolve authorization.
operating_guidance.establish: Identify DHCP servers or IPAM sources and reconciliation owner.
operating_guidance.operate: Collect observations and resolve inventory differences.

requirements.title: Establish and Maintain a Software Inventory
requirements.control_name: Inventory and Control of Software Assets
requirements.guidance: Track installed software, ownership, licensing and business purpose.

requirements.title: Ensure Authorized Software is Currently Supported
requirements.control_name: Inventory and Control of Software Assets
requirements.guidance: Check vendor support and document necessary unsupported-software exceptions.

requirements.title: Address Unauthorized Software
requirements.control_name: Inventory and Control of Software Assets
requirements.guidance: Review unauthorized installations and record removal or approved exceptions.

requirements.title: Utilize Automated Software Inventory Tools
requirements.control_name: Inventory and Control of Software Assets
requirements.guidance: Automate installed-software visibility where possible. Maintain discovery coverage and inventory feed.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: IT/provider manages inventory/enforcement; client approves business exceptions.
operating_guidance.establish: Choose coverage and document technical limitations.
operating_guidance.operate: Maintain discovery coverage and inventory feed.

requirements.title: Allowlist Authorized Software
requirements.control_name: Inventory and Control of Software Assets
requirements.source_cadence: Reassess at least every six months.
requirements.guidance: Restrict execution/access to approved applications. Enforce application restrictions.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: IT/provider manages inventory/enforcement; client approves business exceptions.
operating_guidance.establish: Define approved software and exception handling.

requirements.title: Allowlist Authorized Libraries
requirements.control_name: Inventory and Control of Software Assets
requirements.source_cadence: Reassess at least every six months.
requirements.guidance: Prevent unapproved libraries loading. Enforce library controls; handle changes safely.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: IT/provider manages inventory/enforcement; client approves business exceptions.
operating_guidance.establish: Define authorized libraries and deployment limitations.
operating_guidance.operate: Enforce library controls; handle changes safely.

requirements.title: Establish and Maintain a Data Management Process
requirements.guidance: Document data ownership, sensitivity, handling, retention and disposal.

requirements.title: Establish and Maintain a Data Inventory
requirements.guidance: Locate sensitive information and keep its inventory current.

requirements.title: Configure Data Access Control Lists
requirements.guidance: Limit data permissions to justified business needs.

requirements.title: Enforce Data Retention
requirements.guidance: Apply documented minimum and maximum retention periods.

requirements.title: Securely Dispose of Data
requirements.guidance: Select disposal methods appropriate to information sensitivity.

requirements.title: Encrypt Data on End-User Devices
requirements.guidance: Protect sensitive endpoint information with device encryption.

requirements.title: Establish and Maintain a Data Classification Scheme
requirements.guidance: Give information consistent sensitivity classifications. Apply classification in handling decisions.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client determines sensitivity/handling; IT/provider implements protection and supplies coverage.
operating_guidance.establish: Agree classification criteria with data owners.

requirements.title: Document Data Flows
requirements.guidance: Make internal and provider data movements traceable. Maintain flows through service changes.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client determines sensitivity/handling; IT/provider implements protection and supplies coverage.
operating_guidance.establish: Map material flows and external destinations.

requirements.title: Encrypt Data on Removable Media
requirements.guidance: Protect removable-media contents with encryption. Enforce media encryption.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client determines sensitivity/handling; IT/provider implements protection and supplies coverage.
operating_guidance.establish: Define permitted media and encryption arrangements.

requirements.title: Encrypt Sensitive Data in Transit
requirements.guidance: Protect sensitive information during transfer. Maintain encrypted transport.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client determines sensitivity/handling; IT/provider implements protection and supplies coverage.
operating_guidance.establish: Identify sensitive flows and protected transports.

requirements.title: Encrypt Sensitive Data At Rest
requirements.guidance: Protect stored sensitive server/application/database information. Maintain encryption coverage.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client determines sensitivity/handling; IT/provider implements protection and supplies coverage.
operating_guidance.establish: Identify storage and encryption coverage; storage-layer protection suffices for the stated minimum.

requirements.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
requirements.guidance: Keep sensitive processing out of lower-trust environments. Enforce storage and processing separation.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client determines sensitivity/handling; IT/provider implements protection and supplies coverage.
operating_guidance.establish: Define sensitivity boundaries and permitted processing locations.

requirements.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Configuration Process
requirements.control_name: Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
requirements.guidance: Document secure device and software configurations and maintain baselines.

requirements.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Configuration Process for Network Infrastructure
requirements.control_name: Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
requirements.guidance: Maintain documented secure network-device configurations.

requirements.title: Configure Automatic Session Locking on Enterprise Assets
requirements.control_name: Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
requirements.source_cadence: Inactivity: general OS ≤15 minutes; mobile ≤2 minutes
requirements.guidance: Enforce appropriate inactivity lock settings.

requirements.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
requirements.control_name: Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
requirements.guidance: Enable supported server firewall protections.

requirements.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on End-User Devices
requirements.control_name: Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
requirements.guidance: Use default-deny endpoint firewall rules with justified exceptions.

requirements.title: Securely Manage Enterprise Assets and Software
requirements.control_name: Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
requirements.guidance: Use secure administrative channels and controlled configuration changes.

requirements.title: Manage Default Accounts on Enterprise Assets and Software
requirements.control_name: Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
requirements.guidance: Disable or secure preconfigured accounts.

requirements.title: Uninstall or Disable Unnecessary Services on Enterprise Assets and Software
requirements.control_name: Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
requirements.guidance: Remove unnecessary exposed functionality. Remove or disable unnecessary services.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client approves baseline and exceptions; administrators/provider configure and report.
operating_guidance.establish: Identify required services and approved baselines.

requirements.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
requirements.control_name: Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
requirements.guidance: Use trustworthy infrastructure name resolution. Maintain trusted resolver settings.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client approves baseline and exceptions; administrators/provider configure and report.
operating_guidance.establish: Agree approved DNS resolvers for network infrastructure.

requirements.title: Enforce Automatic Device Lockout on Portable End-User Devices
requirements.control_name: Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
requirements.source_cadence: Where supported: at most 20 failed attempts on laptops; 10 on tablets/phones.
requirements.guidance: Limit repeated local authentication failures on portable devices. Enforce lockout thresholds.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client approves baseline and exceptions; administrators/provider configure and report.
operating_guidance.establish: Define lockout configuration by device class.

requirements.title: Enforce Remote Wipe Capability on Portable End-User Devices
requirements.control_name: Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
requirements.source_cadence: Event: loss, theft or end of engagement are examples; no fixed interval.
requirements.guidance: Remove enterprise data remotely when appropriate. Maintain capability; execute on approved events.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client approves baseline and exceptions; administrators/provider configure and report.
operating_guidance.establish: Establish authorized wipe process for enterprise-owned portable devices.
operating_guidance.operate: Maintain capability; execute on approved events.

requirements.title: Establish and Maintain an Inventory of Accounts
requirements.guidance: Inventory accounts and verify continuing authorization.

requirements.title: Use Unique Passwords
requirements.guidance: Use distinct passwords; source guidance distinguishes MFA and non-MFA accounts.

requirements.title: Disable Dormant Accounts
requirements.source_cadence: After 45 days of inactivity, where supported
requirements.guidance: Detect inactive accounts and disable or remove them.

requirements.title: Restrict Administrator Privileges to Dedicated Administrator Accounts
requirements.guidance: Separate privileged administration from ordinary computing.

requirements.title: Establish and Maintain an Inventory of Service Accounts
requirements.guidance: Keep service-account purpose and ownership accountable. Maintain inventory through account changes.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client authorizes accounts; identity operator/provider maintains controls and inventories.
operating_guidance.establish: Identify service accounts, department owners, purpose and review dates.
operating_guidance.operate: Maintain inventory through account changes. Service-account records identify the responsible department, owner, purpose and review date; authorization reviews occur at least quarterly.

requirements.title: Centralize Account Management
requirements.guidance: Consolidate account administration. Operate centralized account management.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client authorizes accounts; identity operator/provider maintains controls and inventories.
operating_guidance.establish: Identify directory/identity authority and exceptions.

requirements.title: Establish an Access Granting Process
requirements.guidance: Document and follow access approval and provisioning.

requirements.title: Establish an Access Revoking Process
requirements.source_cadence: Immediately at termination, revocation or role change
requirements.guidance: Revoke access immediately on termination, rights revocation or role change; retain disabled accounts when needed to preserve audit history.

requirements.title: Require MFA for Externally-Exposed Applications
requirements.guidance: Enforce supported MFA for externally accessible applications.

requirements.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
requirements.guidance: Protect remote network entry with MFA.

requirements.title: Require MFA for Administrative Access
requirements.guidance: Apply supported MFA to privileged accounts.

requirements.title: Establish and Maintain an Inventory of Authentication and Authorization Systems
requirements.guidance: Identify all authentication/authorization systems. Maintain system inventory.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: HR/business owners trigger changes; identity operator/provider executes and documents.
operating_guidance.establish: Inventory internal and provider-hosted identity systems.

requirements.title: Centralize Access Control
requirements.source_cadence: No numeric interval specified; where supported.
requirements.guidance: Consolidate supported access enforcement. Operate centralized access control.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: HR/business owners trigger changes; identity operator/provider executes and documents.
operating_guidance.establish: Define directory/SSO coverage and limitations.

requirements.title: Establish and Maintain a Vulnerability Management Process
requirements.guidance: Document how vulnerabilities are identified and managed.

requirements.title: Establish and Maintain a Remediation Process
requirements.guidance: Review a documented risk-prioritized remediation process.

requirements.title: Perform Automated Operating System Patch Management
requirements.guidance: Automate operating-system updates and manage failed deployments.

requirements.title: Perform Automated Application Patch Management
requirements.guidance: Automate application updates and manage failed deployments.

requirements.title: Perform Automated Vulnerability Scans of Internal Enterprise Assets
requirements.source_cadence: At least quarterly; authenticated and unauthenticated scans.
requirements.guidance: Find internal vulnerabilities with both scan perspectives. Run scans and route results.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client prioritizes risk; IT/provider scans, patches and remediates.
operating_guidance.establish: Define internal scope, credentials and authorized scanning windows.

requirements.title: Perform Automated Vulnerability Scans of Externally-Exposed Enterprise Assets
requirements.guidance: Find weaknesses in externally exposed assets. Run external scans and route results.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client prioritizes risk; IT/provider scans, patches and remediates.
operating_guidance.establish: Identify external attack surface and scanning owner.
operating_guidance.operate: Run external scans and route results.

requirements.title: Remediate Detected Vulnerabilities
requirements.source_cadence: Remediation at least monthly, following the remediation process.
requirements.guidance: Resolve detected software weaknesses systematically. Remediate and validate outcomes.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client prioritizes risk; IT/provider scans, patches and remediates.
operating_guidance.establish: Define triage and remediation accountability.

requirements.title: Establish and Maintain an Audit Log Management Process
requirements.guidance: Document log collection, retention and review expectations.

requirements.title: Collect Audit Logs
requirements.source_cadence: As defined by the logging process
requirements.guidance: Enable required audit events across assets.

requirements.title: Ensure Adequate Audit Log Storage
requirements.source_cadence: As defined by the logging process
requirements.guidance: Size and manage storage to meet documented logging needs.

requirements.title: Standardize Time Synchronization
requirements.source_cadence: No numeric interval; at least two synchronized sources where supported.
requirements.guidance: Make event times comparable. Operate time synchronization.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client sets scope and escalation; internal team/provider collects and reviews logs.
operating_guidance.establish: Define time sources and supported asset coverage.

requirements.title: Collect Detailed Audit Logs
requirements.guidance: Configure detailed audit logs on enterprise assets containing sensitive data, including the event source, date, username, timestamp, source and destination addresses, and other useful investigation details.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client sets scope and escalation; internal team/provider collects and reviews logs.
operating_guidance.establish: Identify sensitive-data assets and define the required detailed logging fields.
operating_guidance.operate: Collect the event source, date, username, timestamp, source and destination addresses, and other useful investigation details. Identify missing required fields as coverage gaps; availability alone does not remove the requirement.

requirements.title: Collect DNS Query Audit Logs
requirements.source_cadence: No numeric interval; where appropriate and supported.
requirements.guidance: Preserve relevant DNS-query observations. Collect DNS query events.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client sets scope and escalation; internal team/provider collects and reviews logs.
operating_guidance.establish: Identify DNS logging coverage and limitations.

requirements.title: Collect URL Request Audit Logs
requirements.source_cadence: No numeric interval; where appropriate and supported.
requirements.guidance: Preserve relevant web-request observations. Collect URL request events.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client sets scope and escalation; internal team/provider collects and reviews logs.
operating_guidance.establish: Identify URL logging coverage and limitations.

requirements.title: Collect Command-Line Audit Logs
requirements.guidance: Make command execution traceable. Collect command-line events.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client sets scope and escalation; internal team/provider collects and reviews logs.
operating_guidance.establish: Define command-line logging sources.

requirements.title: Centralize Audit Logs
requirements.source_cadence: No numeric interval; centralize to the extent possible.
requirements.guidance: Make logs jointly accessible for investigation. Operate centralized collection/retention.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client sets scope and escalation; internal team/provider collects and reviews logs.
operating_guidance.establish: Define central destinations and exceptions.

requirements.title: Retain Audit Logs
requirements.guidance: Keep adequate historical audit events. Retain events throughout the required window.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client sets scope and escalation; internal team/provider collects and reviews logs.
operating_guidance.establish: Configure retention and capacity together.
operating_guidance.operate: Retain events throughout the required window.

requirements.title: Conduct Audit Log Reviews
requirements.guidance: Detect suspicious behavior through log examination. Review logs and investigate anomalies.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client sets scope and escalation; internal team/provider collects and reviews logs.
operating_guidance.establish: Assign log-review coverage, escalation and substitute coverage.

requirements.title: Ensure Use of Only Fully Supported Browsers and Email Clients
requirements.guidance: Restrict browser and email software to current supported releases.

requirements.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
requirements.guidance: Block known malicious domains for local and remote endpoints.

requirements.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
requirements.guidance: Limit risky web destinations through network controls. Enforce and update URL filtering.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client sets acceptable use; IT/mail provider configures protections.
operating_guidance.establish: Define network URL restrictions for all enterprise assets.

requirements.title: Restrict Unnecessary or Unauthorized Browser and Email Client Extensions
requirements.guidance: Uninstall or disable unauthorized or unnecessary browser and email-client plugins, extensions and add-on applications.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client sets acceptable use; IT/mail provider configures protections.
operating_guidance.establish: Identify authorized and necessary browser and email-client plugins, extensions and add-on applications across the covered assets.
operating_guidance.operate: Uninstall or disable unauthorized or unnecessary browser and email-client plugins, extensions and add-on applications.

requirements.title: Implement DMARC
requirements.guidance: Authenticate domain email to reduce spoofing. Operate domain authentication.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client sets acceptable use; IT/mail provider configures protections.
operating_guidance.establish: Establish SPF/DKIM before DMARC policy and verification.

requirements.title: Block Unnecessary File Types
requirements.guidance: Prevent unwanted email attachment types entering. Enforce email file-type blocking.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client sets acceptable use; IT/mail provider configures protections.
operating_guidance.establish: Agree unnecessary file types and gateway coverage.

requirements.title: Deploy and Maintain Anti-Malware Software
requirements.guidance: Maintain endpoint malware protection.

requirements.title: Configure Automatic Anti-Malware Signature Updates
requirements.guidance: Keep malware detection signatures automatically updated.

requirements.title: Disable Autorun and Autoplay for Removable Media
requirements.guidance: Prevent removable media from executing automatically.

requirements.title: Configure Automatic Anti-Malware Scanning of Removable Media
requirements.source_cadence: Automatic scanning on media use; no calendar interval.
requirements.guidance: Inspect removable media automatically. Run automatic media malware scans.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: IT/provider maintains protection; client approves coverage exceptions.
operating_guidance.establish: Configure scanning coverage.

requirements.title: Enable Anti-Exploitation Features
requirements.guidance: Use available exploitation resistance. Maintain enabled anti-exploitation features.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: IT/provider maintains protection; client approves coverage exceptions.
operating_guidance.establish: Identify supported asset/software protections.

requirements.title: Centrally Manage Anti-Malware Software
requirements.guidance: Coordinate malware protection centrally. Maintain centralized policy and coverage.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: IT/provider maintains protection; client approves coverage exceptions.
operating_guidance.establish: Define central management and asset enrollment.

requirements.title: Use Behavior-Based Anti-Malware Software
requirements.guidance: Detect malware by behavior. Operate behavior-based malware protection.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: IT/provider maintains protection; client approves coverage exceptions.
operating_guidance.establish: Establish behavior-detection coverage.

requirements.title: Establish and Maintain a Data Recovery Process
requirements.guidance: Document recovery scope, priorities, backup procedures and protection.

requirements.title: Perform Automated Backups
requirements.source_cadence: Weekly or more often, based on sensitivity
requirements.guidance: Automate in-scope backups and investigate failures.

requirements.title: Protect Recovery Data
requirements.guidance: Protect backups consistently with original-data sensitivity.

requirements.title: Establish and Maintain an Isolated Instance of Recovery Data
requirements.guidance: Maintain a backup copy isolated from primary-system compromise.

requirements.title: Test Data Recovery
requirements.guidance: Demonstrate sampled recovery actually works. Execute restore tests and resolve failures.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client sets recovery priorities; IT/provider operates backups and tests restoration.
operating_guidance.establish: Select representative recovery samples and success criteria.
operating_guidance.operate: Execute restore tests and resolve failures.

requirements.title: Ensure Network Infrastructure is Up-to-Date
requirements.guidance: Verify network software support and maintain current infrastructure.

requirements.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
requirements.guidance: Design segmented, least-privilege, available networks. Maintain implemented network architecture.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client approves boundaries; network operator/provider implements and documents.
operating_guidance.establish: Define architecture and security boundaries.

requirements.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
requirements.guidance: Protect network administration. Use secure infrastructure management.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client approves boundaries; network operator/provider implements and documents.
operating_guidance.establish: Define secure administrative methods.

requirements.title: Establish and Maintain Architecture Diagram(s)
requirements.guidance: Keep network architecture understandable and current. Maintain documentation with network changes.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client approves boundaries; network operator/provider implements and documents.
operating_guidance.establish: Establish diagrams or equivalent system documentation.

requirements.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
requirements.guidance: Consolidate network identity, permissions and audit. Operate centralized network AAA.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client approves boundaries; network operator/provider implements and documents.
operating_guidance.establish: Define centralized AAA coverage.

requirements.title: Use of Secure Network Management and Communication Protocols
requirements.guidance: Protect network management and communications. Maintain secure protocol configurations.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client approves boundaries; network operator/provider implements and documents.
operating_guidance.establish: Select secure protocols for applicable network services.

requirements.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise's AAA Infrastructure
requirements.guidance: Authenticate remote devices through enterprise VPN/AAA. Require VPN and authentication before resource access.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client approves boundaries; network operator/provider implements and documents.
operating_guidance.establish: Define enterprise-managed remote-access path and authentication.
operating_guidance.operate: Require VPN and authentication before resource access.

requirements.title: Centralize Security Event Alerting
requirements.guidance: Correlate security events into actionable alerts. Operate correlated security alerting.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client owns response decisions; network/SOC/provider operates detection and escalates.
operating_guidance.establish: Define correlation, alert ownership and escalation; equivalent log analytics can satisfy the outcome.

requirements.title: Deploy a Host-Based Intrusion Detection Solution
requirements.guidance: Detect intrusions on supported/appropriate hosts. Operate host intrusion detection.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client owns response decisions; network/SOC/provider operates detection and escalates.
operating_guidance.establish: Define host detection coverage and limitations.

requirements.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
requirements.guidance: Detect network intrusions where appropriate. Operate network intrusion detection.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client owns response decisions; network/SOC/provider operates detection and escalates.
operating_guidance.establish: Select observation points or equivalent cloud capability.

requirements.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
requirements.source_cadence: No numeric interval specified; where appropriate.
requirements.guidance: Control traffic crossing network boundaries. Enforce boundary filtering.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client owns response decisions; network/SOC/provider operates detection and escalates.
operating_guidance.establish: Define permitted inter-segment flows.

requirements.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
requirements.source_cadence: On remote connection; no numeric interval.
requirements.guidance: Condition remote access on asset security posture. Apply posture-based access decisions.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client owns response decisions; network/SOC/provider operates detection and escalates.
operating_guidance.establish: Define checks for malware protection, configuration and patch currency.

requirements.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
requirements.guidance: Make network flows available for review/alerts. Collect network flow or traffic records.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client owns response decisions; network/SOC/provider operates detection and escalates.
operating_guidance.establish: Identify flow/traffic collection coverage and destinations.
operating_guidance.operate: Collect network flow or traffic records.

requirements.title: Establish and Maintain a Security Awareness Program
requirements.source_cadence: Training at hire and annually; content review annually and on significant change
requirements.guidance: Maintain an awareness program and review content; track workforce participation.

requirements.title: Train Workforce Members to Recognize Social Engineering Attacks
requirements.guidance: Teach recognition of phishing and other social manipulation.

requirements.title: Train Workforce Members on Authentication Best Practices
requirements.guidance: Teach secure authentication and credential handling.

requirements.title: Train Workforce on Data Handling Best Practices
requirements.guidance: Teach safe storage, sharing and disposal of sensitive information.

requirements.title: Train Workforce Members on Causes of Unintentional Data Exposure
requirements.guidance: Explain accidental disclosure and prevention.

requirements.title: Train Workforce Members on Recognizing and Reporting Security Incidents
requirements.guidance: Teach workers to identify and report potential incidents.

requirements.title: Train Workforce on How to Identify and Report if Their Enterprise Assets are Missing Security Updates
requirements.guidance: Teach recognition and reporting of failed security updates.

requirements.title: Train Workforce on the Dangers of Connecting to and Transmitting Enterprise Data Over Insecure Networks
requirements.guidance: Cover insecure connections and safe remote/home networking.

requirements.title: Conduct Role-Specific Security Awareness and Skills Training
requirements.source_cadence: No separate numeric interval in 14.9; select role-based schedule.
requirements.guidance: Prepare people for their security-specific duties. Deliver role-specific awareness/skills training.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client identifies people/roles; internal trainers or providers deliver and record participation.
operating_guidance.establish: Identify role skills and training gaps.

requirements.title: Establish and Maintain an Inventory of Service Providers
requirements.guidance: Inventory providers, classifications and accountable contacts.

requirements.title: Establish and Maintain a Service Provider Management Policy
requirements.guidance: Govern the provider lifecycle consistently. Follow the approved provider policy.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client defines policy and accepts contracts; providers supply security commitments.
operating_guidance.establish: Document inventory, classification, assessment, monitoring and decommissioning policy.
operating_guidance.operate: Follow the approved provider policy. The provider policy addresses classification, inventory, assessment, monitoring and decommissioning. This policy does not add the separate IG3 safeguards 15.5 through 15.7 to IG2.

requirements.title: Classify Service Providers
requirements.guidance: Prioritize providers by relevant exposure. Classify providers and update changes.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client defines policy and accepts contracts; providers supply security commitments.
operating_guidance.establish: Agree provider classification criteria.

requirements.title: Ensure Service Provider Contracts Include Security Requirements
requirements.guidance: Align provider contracts with security policy. Maintain contractual security commitments.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client defines policy and accepts contracts; providers supply security commitments.
operating_guidance.establish: Identify required security terms and gaps.

requirements.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Application Development Process
requirements.guidance: Make secure development repeatable. Follow secure lifecycle procedures.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client owns delivery/security decisions; development team or contracted developer performs work.
operating_guidance.establish: Define development security process and responsibilities.
operating_guidance.operate: Follow secure lifecycle procedures. The development process addresses secure design, coding, developer training, vulnerability handling, third-party software security and application testing.

requirements.title: Establish and Maintain a Process to Accept and Address Software Vulnerabilities
requirements.source_cadence: Annual/change process review; intake when reports arrive.
requirements.guidance: Handle reported software weaknesses through resolution. Receive, assign, remediate and retest reports.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client owns delivery/security decisions; development team or contracted developer performs work.
operating_guidance.establish: Establish external reporting path, triage, severity tracking and timing metrics.
operating_guidance.operate: Receive, assign, remediate and retest reports. Provide an external reporting channel and documented intake, ownership, remediation and retesting. Track severity and identification, analysis and remediation dates; review the handling process annually and after significant changes.

requirements.title: Perform Root Cause Analysis on Security Vulnerabilities
requirements.source_cadence: When reviewing vulnerabilities; no numeric interval.
requirements.guidance: Address recurring causes of software vulnerabilities. Analyze causes and prevention actions.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client owns delivery/security decisions; development team or contracted developer performs work.
operating_guidance.establish: Define root-cause responsibilities.

requirements.title: Establish and Manage an Inventory of Third-Party Software Components
requirements.source_cadence: Evaluate component inventory at least monthly.
requirements.guidance: Know component dependencies and their risks. Check changes, updates and continued support.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client owns delivery/security decisions; development team or contracted developer performs work.
operating_guidance.establish: Inventory current/planned third-party components and risks.
operating_guidance.operate: Check changes, updates and continued support. Track current and planned components, associated risks, updates and support status. Review component inventory at least monthly and identify unsupported components.

requirements.title: Use Up-to-Date and Trusted Third-Party Software Components
requirements.source_cadence: At component selection/use; no numeric interval.
requirements.guidance: Use trustworthy, maintained software dependencies. Obtain trusted, up-to-date components.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client owns delivery/security decisions; development team or contracted developer performs work.
operating_guidance.establish: Define acquisition and vulnerability-evaluation practices.
operating_guidance.operate: Obtain trusted, up-to-date components. Use current trusted components and established frameworks or libraries where possible. Obtain components from trusted sources or evaluate vulnerabilities before use.

requirements.title: Establish and Maintain a Severity Rating System and Process for Application Vulnerabilities
requirements.source_cadence: Review severity system/process at least annually.
requirements.guidance: Prioritize application weaknesses and control releases. Triage vulnerabilities and apply release criteria.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client owns delivery/security decisions; development team or contracted developer performs work.
operating_guidance.establish: Define severity model and minimum release acceptance.
operating_guidance.operate: Triage vulnerabilities and apply release criteria. Use a consistent vulnerability severity system with a minimum acceptance threshold for release; review the system annually.

requirements.title: Use Standard Hardening Configuration Templates for Application Infrastructure
requirements.guidance: Use industry-recommended hardening templates for application infrastructure: underlying servers, databases, web servers, cloud containers, Platform as a Service (PaaS) and Software as a Service (SaaS) components. In-house developed software must not weaken configuration hardening.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client owns delivery/security decisions; development team or contracted developer performs work.
operating_guidance.establish: Adopt industry-recommended hardening templates for underlying servers, databases, web servers, cloud containers, PaaS and SaaS application components.
operating_guidance.operate: Maintain application infrastructure hardening across the covered components. Do not allow in-house developed software to weaken configuration hardening.

requirements.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
requirements.guidance: Separate live and non-live application environments. Maintain environment separation.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client owns delivery/security decisions; development team or contracted developer performs work.
operating_guidance.establish: Define production/non-production boundaries.

requirements.title: Train Developers in Application Security Concepts and Secure Coding
requirements.guidance: Equip developers to write secure code. Deliver environment-specific developer training.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client owns delivery/security decisions; development team or contracted developer performs work.
operating_guidance.establish: Identify development roles and relevant training.

requirements.title: Apply Secure Design Principles in Application Architectures
requirements.source_cadence: During design; no numeric interval specified.
requirements.guidance: Build security into application architecture. Apply principles through design and change.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client owns delivery/security decisions; development team or contracted developer performs work.
operating_guidance.establish: Define secure design principles and review responsibility.
operating_guidance.operate: Apply principles through design and change. Apply least privilege, check access at each operation, validate untrusted input type, size, range and format, and minimize exposed functionality.

requirements.title: Leverage Vetted Modules or Services for Application Security Components
requirements.source_cadence: At selection/use; no numeric interval specified.
requirements.guidance: Use established security building blocks. Maintain use of proven identity, crypto and audit capabilities.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client owns delivery/security decisions; development team or contracted developer performs work.
operating_guidance.establish: Identify vetted security modules/services.
operating_guidance.operate: Maintain use of proven identity, crypto and audit capabilities. Use vetted identity, cryptographic, audit and logging modules with accepted reviewed algorithms; avoid custom security implementations.

requirements.title: Designate Personnel to Manage Incident Handling
requirements.guidance: Identify incident leadership, backup coverage and internal oversight.

requirements.title: Establish and Maintain Contact Information for Reporting Security Incidents
requirements.guidance: Verify incident notification contacts.

requirements.title: Establish and Maintain an Enterprise Process for Reporting Incidents
requirements.guidance: Document and communicate the workforce incident-reporting process.

requirements.title: Establish and Maintain an Incident Response Process
requirements.guidance: Coordinate complete incident response. Execute response process during incidents.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client retains oversight; internal responders/provider coordinate assigned response duties.
operating_guidance.establish: Document response roles, obligations and communications.
operating_guidance.operate: Execute response process during incidents. Document response roles, compliance obligations and communications, and review the response process annually and after significant changes.

requirements.title: Assign Key Roles and Responsibilities
requirements.guidance: Make incident roles and handoffs explicit. Activate assigned roles during incidents.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client retains oversight; internal responders/provider coordinate assigned response duties.
operating_guidance.establish: Agree cross-functional and provider responsibilities.
operating_guidance.operate: Activate assigned roles during incidents. Include relevant legal, IT, security, facilities, public relations, HR, responders, analysts and third-party responsibilities.

requirements.title: Define Mechanisms for Communicating During Incident Response
requirements.guidance: Keep incident communications usable during disruption. Use available incident communication channels.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client retains oversight; internal responders/provider coordinate assigned response duties.
operating_guidance.establish: Define primary and fallback communication methods.
operating_guidance.operate: Use available incident communication channels. Define primary and alternate incident communication channels, accounting for unavailable or compromised email.

requirements.title: Conduct Routine Incident Response Exercises
requirements.guidance: Exercise incident decisions and coordination. Run exercises covering channels, decisions and workflows.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client retains oversight; internal responders/provider coordinate assigned response duties.
operating_guidance.establish: Plan realistic scenarios, participants and objectives.
operating_guidance.operate: Run exercises covering channels, decisions and workflows. Conduct actual exercises at least annually that test communications, decisions and response workflows; track resulting improvements.

requirements.title: Conduct Post-Incident Reviews
requirements.source_cadence: After incidents; no fixed calendar interval.
requirements.guidance: Learn from actual incidents. Capture lessons and assign improvements.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client retains oversight; internal responders/provider coordinate assigned response duties.
operating_guidance.establish: Define post-incident review responsibility.
operating_guidance.operate: Capture lessons and assign improvements. After incidents, capture lessons and follow up improvements. The safeguard does not prescribe a separate fixed numeric review interval.

requirements.title: Establish and Maintain a Penetration Testing Program
requirements.source_cadence: Program-defined frequency; no separate numeric minimum in 18.1.
requirements.guidance: Make penetration testing purposeful and controlled. Maintain the testing program.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client authorizes tests and priorities; qualified tester executes; owners remediate.
operating_guidance.establish: Agree scope, frequency, limits, contacts, remediation and retrospectives.
operating_guidance.operate: Maintain the testing program. Scale testing to organizational size, complexity, industry and maturity. Define network, application, API, hosted and physical scope where relevant, frequency, testing limits and hours, excluded attacks, contacts, remediation routing and retrospective review.

requirements.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
requirements.guidance: Have qualified testers probe external exposure. Execute external penetration tests.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client authorizes tests and priorities; qualified tester executes; owners remediate.
operating_guidance.establish: Select qualified party and authorize scope/limits.
operating_guidance.operate: Execute external penetration tests. At least annually, use qualified external testers and include reconnaissance of the enterprise and its environment.

requirements.title: Remediate Penetration Test Findings
requirements.source_cadence: After findings, on risk-prioritized remediation timelines.
requirements.guidance: Resolve penetration-test weaknesses by risk. Remediate penetration-test findings.

operating_guidance.client_provider_split: Client authorizes tests and priorities; qualified tester executes; owners remediate.
operating_guidance.establish: Define finding ownership and routing.
operating_guidance.operate: Remediate penetration-test findings. Prioritize test findings by risk and apply documented vulnerability remediation timelines and effort according to impact and priority.

review_plans.title: Enterprise Asset Inventory Review
review_plans.source_cadence: 1.1: six-month inventory review; 1.2: weekly operational handling, not weekly human Review
review_plans.reason: Group related validation work into one authoritative Review while retaining each safeguard's source semantics.

review_plans.title: Software Authorization & Support Review
review_plans.source_cadence: 2.2, 2.3 and 12.1: monthly review; 2.1: six-month inventory review; 9.1: implementation state
review_plans.reason: Group related validation work into one authoritative Review while retaining each safeguard's source semantics.

review_plans.title: Data Management & Inventory Review
review_plans.source_cadence: 3.1, 3.2: annual review; significant change also triggers 3.1; other safeguards provide supporting context
review_plans.reason: Group related validation work into one authoritative Review while retaining each safeguard's source semantics.

review_plans.title: Secure Configuration Process Review
review_plans.source_cadence: 4.1, 4.2: annual documentation review and significant change
review_plans.reason: Group related validation work into one authoritative Review while retaining each safeguard's source semantics.

review_plans.title: Account Authorization & Access Review
review_plans.source_cadence: 5.1: quarterly authorization validation; 5.3: 45-day operational inactivity threshold; 6.1/6.2: event-driven
review_plans.reason: Group related validation work into one authoritative Review while retaining each safeguard's source semantics.

review_plans.title: Vulnerability & Remediation Process Review
review_plans.source_cadence: 7.2: monthly process review; 7.1: annual/change review; 7.3/7.4: monthly operational patching
review_plans.reason: Group related validation work into one authoritative Review while retaining each safeguard's source semantics.

review_plans.title: Audit Log Management Process Review
review_plans.reason: Group related validation work into one authoritative Review while retaining each safeguard's source semantics.
review_plans.ig2_operating_context: 8.11: actual log examination at least weekly; 8.10: at least 90 days retention. An annual governance meeting is insufficient to perform these duties.

review_plans.title: Data Recovery Governance Review
review_plans.source_cadence: 11.1: annual/change process review; 11.2: weekly operational backups, not a weekly human Review
review_plans.reason: Group related validation work into one authoritative Review while retaining each safeguard's source semantics.
review_plans.ig2_operating_context: 11.5: execute sampled recovery tests at least quarterly. Keep annual governance and separately link dated quarterly restore results.

review_plans.title: Security Awareness Program Review
review_plans.source_cadence: 14.1: annual/change content review and training at hire/annually; remaining safeguards are training topics
review_plans.reason: Group related validation work into one authoritative Review while retaining each safeguard's source semantics.

review_plans.title: Service Provider Inventory Review
review_plans.source_cadence: 15.1: annual inventory review and significant change; not a separate assurance review for every vendor
review_plans.reason: Group related validation work into one authoritative Review while retaining each safeguard's source semantics.

review_plans.title: Incident Reporting & Contact Review
review_plans.source_cadence: 17.1–17.3: annual personnel, contact and reporting-process review; significant change for 17.1/17.3
review_plans.reason: Group related validation work into one authoritative Review while retaining each safeguard's source semantics.

review_plans.title: Endpoint Protection Validation
review_plans.source_cadence: No prescribed human-review interval; quarterly validation is an Omnisciente recommendation
review_plans.reason: Periodically validate implementation without turning automatic operational activity into a mandated Review.

review_plans.title: Network Defense Validation
review_plans.source_cadence: Operational intervals and event triggers remain safeguard-specific; this Review evaluates actual execution and follow-up.
review_plans.reason: Group related work without replacing external technical activity or automatically changing an existing schedule.

review_plans.title: Secure Development & Component Review
review_plans.source_cadence: Operational intervals and event triggers remain safeguard-specific; this Review evaluates actual execution and follow-up.
review_plans.reason: Group related work without replacing external technical activity or automatically changing an existing schedule.
review_plans.ig2_operating_context: 16.4: component evaluation at least monthly; 16.9: developer training at least annually; lifecycle and reporting duties continue between Reviews.

review_plans.title: External Penetration Testing Program Review
review_plans.source_cadence: Operational intervals and event triggers remain safeguard-specific; this Review evaluates actual execution and follow-up.
review_plans.reason: Group related work without replacing external technical activity or automatically changing an existing schedule.
review_plans.ig2_operating_context: 18.2: qualified external testing at least annually, including reconnaissance; 18.3: risk-prioritized remediation. A Review alone is not a penetration test.

policy_mappings.rationale: CIS 3.1 calls for a documented data-management process; this document may house that process, not a mandated standalone policy title.
Supports retention and disposal within the documented data-management process.
Documented secure-configuration processes are required; the document must contain the actual processes.
Supports account governance and the documented access-granting process; not an exact policy-title mandate.
Documented vulnerability and remediation processes; operational patch frequency remains separate.
May reference the documented log-management process; the policy alone does not demonstrate implementation.
Must actually document recovery and backup procedures to represent the required process.
Supports the awareness program; CIS does not mandate this exact standalone policy.
Can contain the documented workforce reporting process and contacts; not a claim that all incident-policy content is IG1-required.
